book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: A JE' JU'UNA', RAJI' TI' U YET WINIQUIROB JUDÍO A CU TSICBAROB U T'ɅN HEBREO HEBREOS

content: Mʌ' ja wirej, jujuntur sacerdote, a jach no'jo', toc teta'an ti' tu cotor mac ich u winiquirob israel soc u t'ʌnicob C'uj ti' u rac'ob. Rajen teta'b soc quinsic u yʌrʌc'ob mac quir u toquic quir u sijic ti' C'uj quir u ruc'sic u si'pir u rac'ob.

Rajen, raji' c'ucha'an yor u yirej otsir u rac'ob quire' u bʌjiri' yer mʌ' c'ucha'an yor ti' tu cotor a ba' a cu tar ti'. Rajen nemʌ' biqui' ich u rac'ob a sacerdote quir u yamtic a mac a jach ama'an u cʌnic ba', cax yejer mac a tu pʌy u si'pir.
Mʌ' ja wirej, u bʌjirirob a sacerdotejo' yʌn u quinsic yʌrʌc' quir u toquic quir u sijic ti' C'uj u bo'orir u wʌc'ʌs si'pir u bʌjiri' an ten bic u rac'ob xan.

Mʌna' mac c'ucha'an yor u tetic quir u beyaj a sacerdotejo' soc u bʌjiri' cu yocar beyaj sacerdote a no'jo'. Chen u bʌjiri' C'uj c'ucha'an yor u tetic soc yocar beyaj sacerdote an ten bic ts'a'b u beyaj Aarón ten C'uj uch.
Bayiri' xan, Cristo. U bʌjiri', quij, mʌ' tu tetaj u bʌjiri' quir u beyaj quir u yocar sacerdote, a no'jo'. Mʌ' ja wirej, u bʌjiri' C'uj caj u ts'ajaj u beyaj quire'. C'uj caj u ya'araj ti':

content.text: A techo', quij C'uj, in pararech. Tin pararinquintajech baje'rer, quij.

content: Baxuc xan ti' wʌc'ʌs ara'b ti' ten C'uj an ten bic ts'iba'an ich u t'ʌn C'uj uch:

content.text: A teno', quij C'uj, tin tetajech soc a wocar sacerdotejech a jach no'jo' soc yʌn tech u muc' a Melquisedeco'. Munt q'uin yʌn tech u muc' Melquisedec.

content: Wa ber cuxa'an Jesús te'ra' ich yoc'ocab uch. Jach chich caj u t'ʌnaj C'uj tu cu c'atic a ba' u c'at, tan u yoc'ar ya'arir u wich. Cax yʌn u muc' a C'ujo' quir u to'car Jesús chen quinsa'b uch, quire' baxuc u c'at C'uj. Cax C'uj caj u yubaj u t'ʌn Jesús quire' Jesús rajra' cu quibic u t'ʌn.
Cax a Jesúso' u parar C'uj, cu naj quibic u t'ʌn C'uj Jesús, cax tu cu naj muc'yaj.
Caj ts'oc u quibic tu cotor ba', Jesús caj u c'ub u bʌj soc ca' quimic. Caj quimij soc tu cotor mac a cu bin yacsej tu yor, cu bin tacbir ten Jesús quir u cuxtar munt q'uin.
Quire' a baxuco', quij, rajen a C'ujo' caj u tetaj u parar soc u yocar sacerdote, a jach no'jo' soc yʌn u muc' Melquisedec.
Qui' irex, quij soc mʌ' a p'ʌtiquex a wacsiquex ta worex ti' Jesucristo
Ti' yʌn ya'ab ba' ti' Cristo, a sacerdotejo' a no'jo', quir in camsiquechex chen jach yaj quir a cʌniquex. Mʌ' ja wirej, mʌ' a c'atex a najtexi'.

Jeroj uch, a techexo', caj a wacsex ta worex ti' Jesús. Chen a bʌjiri'ex, mʌ' tan a camsiquex mac u t'ʌn C'uj. Ca chen cʌxtex mac ca' u camsequechex ti' u t'ʌn C'uj, a ba' ta yʌn cʌnajex uch caj a yʌn acsajex ta worex uch. Ta chen cʌnex a chichano', a mʌ' c'ucha'an yor u jantic yo'och, cu chen chuch. Baxuc ta cʌnex, quire' mʌ' tan a qui' najtiquex a ba' cu ya'aric u t'ʌn C'uj, mʌ' tan a manex tu tsoyir xan.
A mac a cu qui' najtic a ba' ts'iba'an ich u t'ʌn C'uj yer bic tabar u tetic a ba' jach tsoy. Cu najtic xan a ba' mʌ' tsoyi'.
